records.source: Now I see you and {0} in a dimly lit room. You look serious... but not unhappy. Something important must be happening.
records.translation: Ngayon, nakikita ko kayo ni {0} sa isang silid na madilim ang ilaw. Mukha kang seryoso... ngunit hindi malungkot. May mahalagang bagay sigurong nagaganap.

records.source: Ooo... It's dark, and I see you and a certain young man. He looks a little bashful, but happy to be with you.
records.translation: Ooo... Madilim, at nakikita kitang kasama ang isang binata. Medyo nahihiya siya, ngunit masaya siyang makasama ka.

records.source: Ooo... It's dark, and I see you and a certain young man. He looks quite hopeful, and eager to spend time with you.
records.translation: Ooo... Madilim, at nakikita kitang kasama ang isang binata. Puno siya ng pag-asa at sabik na makasama ka.

records.source: Ooo... It's dark, and I see you and a certain young lady. She looks a little bashful, but happy to be with you.
records.translation: Ooo... Madilim, at nakikita kitang kasama ang isang dalaga. Medyo nahihiya siya, ngunit masaya siyang makasama ka.

records.source: Ooo... It's dark, and I see you and a certain young lady. She looks quite hopeful, and eager to spend time with you.
records.translation: Ooo... Madilim, at nakikita kitang kasama ang isang dalaga. Puno siya ng pag-asa at sabik na makasama ka.

records.source: Hmmm... now what's this young man's name? ... I believe it starts with an '{0}'.
records.translation: Hmmm... ano nga ba ang pangalan ng binatang ito? ... Sa palagay ko'y nagsisimula iyon sa '{0}'.

records.source: Hmmm... now what's this young lady's name? ... I believe it starts with an '{0}'.
records.translation: Hmmm... ano nga ba ang pangalan ng dalagang ito? ... Sa palagay ko'y nagsisimula iyon sa '{0}'.

records.source: Interesting... I see you and {0} working together on a farm. You seem very pleased about something.
records.translation: Kawili-wili... nakikita ko kayong nagtutulungan ni {0} sa isang bukid. Mukhang tuwang-tuwa ka sa isang bagay.

records.source: Now I see you, middle-aged, walking through town at dusk. You pause at a window to see a family having dinner. You hang your head and hurry off into the darkness.
records.translation: Ngayon, nakikita kitang nasa katanghaliang-gulang at naglalakad sa bayan sa dapithapon. Huminto ka sa tapat ng bintana upang pagmasdan ang isang pamilyang naghahapunan. Niyuko mo ang ulo at nagmadaling lumisan sa dilim.

records.source: The crystal ball has moved on... Now I see you harvesting a plump, ripe melon. You're on a wonderful looking farm, bursting with life!
records.translation: Nagbago na ang tanawin sa bolang kristal... Ngayon, nakikita kitang nag-aani ng malaki at hinog na melon. Nasa isang kahanga-hangang bukid ka, at punô iyon ng buhay!

records.source: The crystal ball has moved on... I see you somewhere dark... but there you are, inspecting a marvelous gemstone! It's glittering in the light of a small lantern.
records.translation: Nagbago na ang tanawin sa bolang kristal... Nakikita kita sa isang madilim na lugar... at naroon ka, sinusuri ang isang kahanga-hangang hiyas! Kumikislap ito sa liwanag ng munting parol.

records.source: The crystal ball has moved on... AH! You're in combat! There's something dreadful bearing down on you from the dark, but you seem more than ready to face it.
records.translation: Nagbago na ang tanawin sa bolang kristal... AH! Nakikipaglaban ka! May nakapanghihilakbot na sumusugod sa iyo mula sa dilim, ngunit handang-handa kang harapin ito.

records.source: The crystal ball has moved on... Now I see you relaxing on the riverbanks, holding a fishing pole. Oh! Looks like something big is on the line!
records.translation: Nagbago na ang tanawin sa bolang kristal... Ngayon, nakikita kitang nagpapahinga sa pampang ng ilog habang may hawak na Pamingwit. Ay! Mukhang may malaking kumagat!

records.source: The crystal ball has moved on... It's you... in the forest. You spot some rare and delicious mushrooms hidden beneath a clump of grass... what a find!
records.translation: Nagbago na ang tanawin sa bolang kristal... Ikaw iyon... nasa gubat ka. Nakakita ka ng ilang bihira at masasarap na kabuteng nakatago sa ilalim ng kumpol ng damo... napakagandang tuklas!

records.source: The crystal ball has moved on... I see you in a golden room... grinning about something. Oh, I see... You're playing some kind of game and you just can't lose!
records.translation: Nagbago na ang tanawin sa bolang kristal... Nakikita kita sa isang gintong silid... nakangisi dahil sa isang bagay. Ah, nauunawaan ko na... Naglalaro ka at tila hindi ka matatalo!

records.source: Ah... the crystal ball has gone dim. That's all I can do for you, young one.
records.translation: Ah... lumabo na ang bolang kristal. Iyon lamang ang magagawa ko para sa iyo, bata.

records.source: Now, just keep in mind that the future isn't set in stone! Whatever I've told you today can still be changed, if you set your heart on it. Farewell.
records.translation: Tandaan mong hindi pa nakaukit sa bato ang hinaharap! Mababago pa ang anumang sinabi ko sa iyo ngayon kung buong puso mong nanaisin. Paalam.

records.source: You added {0} to the soup.
records.translation: Idinagdag mo ang {0} sa sabaw.

records.source: Abigail!
records.translation: Abigail!

records.translation: Tabla sa pagitan nina
